# First, identify the unique positions among players from Georgia and Penn State
georgia_players = df[df['school / club team'] == 'georgia']
penn_state_players = df[df['school / club team'] == 'penn state']

# Get the set of positions for each school
georgia_positions = set(georgia_players['position'].unique())
penn_state_positions = set(penn_state_players['position'].unique())

# Check if there are exactly three different positions combined
combined_positions = georgia_positions.union(penn_state_positions)
three_different_positions = len(combined_positions) == 3

# Check if the two schools contributed two of the same positions
two_same_positions = len(georgia_positions.intersection(penn_state_positions)) == 2

# The statement is true only if both conditions hold
answer = three_different_positions and two_same_positions
